item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder implementation has several issues with handling StopIteration and RuntimeError exceptions, causing "Task got bad yield" and "coroutine raised StopIteration" errors. The _send method doesn't properly handle async generator yields and awaitable values.
item.contract: AsyncResultBuilder._send() must properly handle async generators and awaitable values (Results) by correctly awaiting them and propagating StopIteration/StopAsyncIteration exceptions. It should return appropriate Result values when values are yielded or when exceptions occur.
